newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Three dead, 16 hurt in Albania explosion-ministry.
newsitem.headline: Three dead, 16 hurt in Albania explosion-ministry.

text.p: At least three people were killed and 16 injured by an explosion which destroyed three floors of an apartment block in the northeast Albanian town of Peshkopi early on Friday, the Interior Ministry said.
Ministry spokesman Ndrek Gjini told Reuters six other people were missing after the blast, which he said had been caused by explosives planted in the building.
"According to our information, three people have been killed, 16 injured and another six are believed to remain inside," Gjini said.
Early on Tuesday, an explosion destroyed two cafes in central Tirana, slightly injuring one man. Police blamed a business dispute.
Explosives and weapons were looted from arms depots during unrest early this year which followed the collapse of high-interest investment schemes and are frequently used to settle personal disputes.
Albanians are looking to the new government expected to be announced on Friday to restore order.
